name: EnvironmentNetworking
description: EnvironmentNetworking says which websites a sandbox may reach.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Whether network access is unrestricted or limited to listed hosts.

fields.name: AllowedHosts
fields.description:
The hosts a limited sandbox may reach over HTTPS, each a bare domain
 name such as api.github.com, or *. and a domain name, which matches
 exactly one more label: *.example.com matches api.example.com, not
 example.com and not a.b.example.com. No scheme, port or path.

 A request to any other host is refused: an HTTPS connection is closed
 during its handshake, and plain HTTP answers 403 egress denied.

fields.name: AllowPackageManagers
fields.description:
Whether a limited sandbox may also reach the public package registries
 (npm, PyPI, crates.io, the Go module proxy, RubyGems, Maven, Packagist,
 the Debian and Ubuntu archives, the common code hosts and container
 registries).

fields.name: AllowMcpServers
fields.description:
Whether a limited sandbox may also reach the MCP servers of its
 conversation's agent and subagents, by their addresses.
